title: Localized Generative Design of Ship Hulls with Diffusion Models and High-Fidelity Assessment
abstract: arXiv:2610.12870v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Practical ship design requires localized refinement and performance evaluation. This paper presents a reward-directed diffusion framework for localized hull optimization. Parametric masking during dataset generation restricts geometric changes to selected variables, including the bulbous bow and forebody, while preserving full-hull continuity. Surrogate-assisted sequential Monte Carlo sampling targets reduced predicted calm-water resistance, with stability retained through training data and displacement matched during screening. An automated viscous free-surface CFD pipeline, validated against measurements for two benchmark container ships, evaluates a generated variant and GenHull E, a hull refined by a naval architect within the same representation. translated_title: 基于扩散模型与高保真度评估的船体局部化生成设计
translated_abstract: 实际船舶设计需要对局部区域进行精细化改进并进行性能评估。本文提出了一种奖励导向的扩散框架，用于船体局部优化。在数据集生成过程中采用参数化掩码技术，将几何变化限制在选定的变量上（包括球鼻艏和船体前部），同时保持整船的几何连续性。代理模型辅助的序贯蒙特卡洛采样以降低预测的静水阻力为目标，通过训练数据保持稳定性，并在筛选过程中匹配排水量。研究构建了一个自动化的粘性自由液面CFD流程（针对两艘基准集装箱船与实测数据进行了验证），用于评估一个生成的船体变体以及GenHull E——一艘由船舶设计师在同一参数表示框架内改进的船体。在匹配的KRISO集装箱船（KCS）排水量下，生成的变体在傅汝德数Fn=0.195时总阻力与基准相当，但在Fn=0.250和0.260时阻力高出45-50%，这一缺陷被……（摘要原文在此截断）
tldr: 该论文提出一种奖励导向的扩散模型框架，通过参数化掩码实现球鼻艏和船体前部等局部区域的生成式优化，并结合经验证的高保真自动化CFD流程进行评估，发现生成的船体在低速时阻力与基准相当，但在高速时阻力高出45-50%。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a reward-directed diffusion framework for localized ship hull optimization using parametric masking to constrain geometric changes to regions like the bulbous bow, with a validated automated high-fidelity CFD pipeline revealing that the generated variant achieves comparable resistance at low speeds but 45-50% higher resistance at higher speeds.
